# FigureForge upstream code

The modules in this directory include code adapted from
[Top-Conf Paper Figure Gallery](https://github.com/qwdwqfwq/topconf-paper-figure-gallery),
revision `187901c`. They are used under its MIT license; see `LICENSE` and
`NOTICE.md`. Archimedes is an independent derivative, not an official project.

Adaptations include integration with Archimedes model transport, SVG input
sanitization and editable export, and fixes for rotated object bounds. Paper
figures remain hosted by their original gallery and retain their own licenses.
